summary_md: **MarsNext 🛰️ 🔭 👽 ([@0xMarsNext](https://x.com/0xMarsNext/status/2116423977308676518))** built **PhobosStream**, which streams weights from NVMe via mmap so 14B Wan2.1 and 12B DiTs run on 8 GB GPUs or 16 GB Macs, with peak VRAM falling from 38.4 GB to 788 MB. It ships with a ComfyUI node ([martianacademy/phobos-stream](https://github.com/martianacademy/phobos-stream)).
